text:
sofia: Heads-up — Acadia is launching a feature tomorrow and asked for a short-lived egress/allowlist + rate bump for launch traffic. They want APAC traffic to originate from 203.0.113.0/24 and US traffic from 198.51.100.0/24, with a temporary QPS increase to 500 for 72h. Can we do a region pin and auto-revoke?

jon: @sofia ok, we can pin by routing policy to ap-southeast-1 for APAC and us-west-2 for US. Need confirmation on whether they use Dedicated (tenant) or Hosted — affects IPs and certs.

sofia: They are on Dedicated (reserved pool). Confirmed — Dedicated pool id: ded-acadia-03. They asked to avoid anycast so we can split CIDRs per region.

casey: I'll coordinate with the customer for exact start time and get a signed SOC/engagement note. Also flagging renewal: they mentioned enterprise discount contingent on launch metrics — if we miss the window, renewal risk increases.

mike: Network + infra OK. I'll add the two CIDR blocks to the dedicated egress ACL scoped to ded-acadia-03 and create a rate-window rule:

```yaml
customer: acadia
pool: ded-acadia-03
egress:
  - region: ap-southeast-1
    cidr: 203.0.113.0/24
  - region: us-west-2
    cidr: 198.51.100.0/24
rate_limits:
  default_qps: 100
  temp_override:
    qps: 500
    start: 2024-05-25T14:00:00Z
    duration: 72h
auto_revoke: true
```

mike: Will set auto_revoke timer to 72h + 1h buffer and tag config with `cs:acadia-launch`.

jon: Two operational asks: 1) enable canary route to drain to backup model on any token errors, 2) add tracing headers for the launch window so we can correlate latency/regressions.

sofia: Noted — @jon can you add the trace header RFC and link it here? We'll share with Acadia so they can parse logs.

jon: Sure, adding header: `x-rdwd-launch-id: acadia-20240525`. Also enabling short retention of launch logs (14 days).

casey: I'll update the support ticket and the customer playbook. Also scheduling a 30m readiness call 30m before start to confirm metrics. Who can join the call?

mike: I'll join for network handoff. @jon can join for routing/fallback.

sofia: I'll invite product-ops and the CS lead from Acadia.

deploy-bot: Ticket #INC-20240525-ACAD created: assigned to infra-networking (mike), infra-routing (jon), cs (casey). ETA: provisioning within 2 hours of request.

casey: Customer asked about rollback — set fallback to `model-small-v2` and emergency throttle at 120 qps if we see errors. I'll add that to the runbook.

mike: Done — added fallback and emergency rate rule. Will push ACLs in 10m and post the change log here.

sofia: Thanks team. After launch confirm with a short post-mortem and I'll note renewal touchpoints. :thumbsup:
